preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analyzer a WHERE (is_active IS TRUE OR COALESCE(status, 'SETUP') <> 'INACTIVE') AND ( NULLIF(TRIM(bridge_connection_id), '') IS NULL OR site_binding_revision_id IS NULL ) AND NOT ( COALESCE(status, '') = 'SETUP' AND NULLIF(TRIM(bridge_connection_id), '') IS NULL AND site_binding_revision_id IS NULL AND last_activated_date IS NULL AND latest_activation_record_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(test_unit_ids), '') IS NULL AND scrip_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(machine_id), '') IS NULL AND analyzer_type_id IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(identifier_pattern), '') IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_field WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_field_mapping WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_test_map WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_plugin_config WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_experiment WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_file_upload WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_pending_code WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_activation_record WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analyzer_results WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analysis WHERE analyzer_id = a.id) )

changeSet.comment: Complete the verified analyzer cutover. Operational analyzers retain only OpenELIS-owned state and exact Bridge/catalog references. Analyzer communication, profile/runtime configuration, parsing, and portable mappings remain Bridge-owned; inactive intentionally excluded records retain only their non-runtime OpenELIS history. Empty SETUP drafts have no runtime configuration to migrate and retain their identity and lifecycle unchanged. SETUP alone is not evidence of an empty draft: configuration, partial references, and usage history still require a verified cutover.
